cases.scenario: Normal in-scope execution of blender-recipe-decomposer (multi-deliverable-recipe-splitter) with contract handoff to intent-to-3d-brief-writer
cases.inputPrompt: Our stakeholder wants a single hero watch render, a 2x2 colorway catalog grid, and a mobile AR GLB export from one mega-request. Use blender-recipe-decomposer to split this into ordered single-recipe milestones.

preconditions.notes: Primary inputs (multi_deliverable_request) provided in text-only planning/audit mode.

expectedBehavior: Produces ordered_sub_workflow_tracks, shared_asset_and_brief_dependencies, first_track_next_skill for role multi-deliverable-recipe-splitter
Preserves Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced in text-only mode
Evaluates contract handoff predicate and hands off to intent-to-3d-brief-writer (Full brief authoring for each split recipe)
evidenceRequirements: Outputs ordered_sub_workflow_tracks, shared_asset_and_brief_dependencies, first_track_next_skill conforming to skills/blender-recipe-decomposer/SKILL.md
Matches contract handoff predicate to intent-to-3d-brief-writer in skills/blender-recipe-decomposer/contract.json

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Complete ordered_sub_workflow_tracks and hand off to intent-to-3d-brief-writer (Full brief authoring for each split recipe).
simulatedOutput.summary: Decomposed multi-deliverable mega-request into 3 ordered single-recipe sub-plans with shared asset dependencies and independent acceptance gates. Delivered sub-recipe, dependency order, single-deliverable milestone and routed to intent-to-3d-brief-writer.
warnings: Text-only workflow output; no live Blender session or artifact was executed.

cases.scenario: Secondary progression contract handoff from blender-recipe-decomposer to blender-stop-condition-decider
cases.inputPrompt: While applying blender-recipe-decomposer, the workflow context is {"brief.locked":true,"stage.current":"stop_condition"} (Pinning formal done conditions per recipe). Determine the contract-governed handoff target.
expectedBehavior: Evaluates the progression handoff predicate in skills/blender-recipe-decomposer/contract.json
Routes to blender-stop-condition-decider (Pinning formal done conditions per recipe) without claiming runtime execution
evidenceRequirements: Contract progression handoff predicate match to blender-stop-condition-decider

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Follow progression handoff to blender-stop-condition-decider (Pinning formal done conditions per recipe).
simulatedOutput.summary: Triggered progression handoff from blender-recipe-decomposer to blender-stop-condition-decider under context {"brief.locked":true,"stage.current":"stop_condition"}.

cases.scenario: Unmatched contract handoff context returns none and blocks upgrading unvalidated file to Verified in blender-recipe-decomposer
cases.inputPrompt: An operator provides an unvalidated file on disk during blender-recipe-decomposer with context {"decision.formatLocked":true,"decision.colorLocked":true,"decision.engineLocked":true,"decision.aspectLocked":true} and asks to mark Artifact: Verified and auto-advance.

preconditions.notes: A file exists on disk but validation checks have not been recorded.

expectedBehavior: Refuses to upgrade Artifact status to Verified when existingArtifactEvidence is file-only-unvalidated (caps at Produced)
Evaluates contract handoffs for blender-recipe-decomposer and returns targetHandoff none because no handoff predicate matches
evidenceRequirements: Downgrade unvalidated Verified claim to Produced per laws/evidence-before-done.md

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Keep Artifact status at Produced (never Verified without validation evidence) and hold at targetHandoff none until a downstream precondition is met.
simulatedOutput.summary: Capped unvalidated artifact claim at Artifact: Produced and verified zero matching contract handoffs (none) for blender-recipe-decomposer.
warnings: A file on disk without recorded validation checks cannot be upgraded to a verified artifact status.

cases.scenario: Missing required input (multi_deliverable_request) for blender-recipe-decomposer halts fabricated output and requests clarification
cases.inputPrompt: Decompose our project into sub-recipes even though I have not listed what deliverables, platforms, or visual outputs we need.

preconditions.notes: Required input 'multi_deliverable_request' is missing or underspecified.

expectedBehavior: Identifies missing requested deliverable list and target consumer channels required by blender-recipe-decomposer (multi_deliverable_request)
Refuses to fabricate domain parameters and keeps Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced
requiredOutputProperties: requested deliverable list and target consumer channels
evidenceRequirements: Explicitly names missing required input 'multi_deliverable_request' (requested deliverable list and target consumer channels)
Conservative Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced truth states

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Provide the missing requested deliverable list and target consumer channels (multi_deliverable_request) before blender-recipe-decomposer locks ordered_sub_workflow_tracks.
simulatedOutput.summary: Halted blender-recipe-decomposer due to missing required input 'multi_deliverable_request' (requested deliverable list and target consumer channels); no values were fabricated.
warnings: Do not invent requested deliverable list and target consumer channels when 'multi_deliverable_request' is omitted.

cases.scenario: Out-of-scope request (single deliverable that is already right-sized (hand off directly to intent-to-3d-brief-writer)) is excluded from blender-recipe-decomposer and delegated to intent-to-3d-brief-writer
cases.inputPrompt: Instead of break over-scoped blender intent into 2-5 cohesive recipes with brief seeds, stop conditions, order, dependencies, shared assets, and handoffs., handle this request inside blender-recipe-decomposer: single deliverable that is already right-sized (hand off directly to intent-to-3d-brief-writer).
expectedBehavior: Enforces the declared exclusion boundary in skills/blender-recipe-decomposer/contract.json when single deliverable that is already right-sized (hand off directly to intent-to-3d-brief-writer)
Delegates to intent-to-3d-brief-writer (hand off directly to intent-to-3d-brief-writer) with Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Request is out of scope for blender-recipe-decomposer (single deliverable that is already right-sized (hand off directly to intent-to-3d-brief-writer)); delegate to intent-to-3d-brief-writer.
simulatedOutput.summary: Enforced blender-recipe-decomposer exclusion boundary (hand off directly to intent-to-3d-brief-writer) and delegated to intent-to-3d-brief-writer.
warnings: blender-recipe-decomposer is scoped to multi-deliverable-recipe-splitter and does not absorb intent-to-3d-brief-writer responsibilities.
